implementation.result: The deterministic workspace index conditionally exposes a fifth primary card titled 'Models and comparison scopes' when the verified cross-model HTML member exists.

workspace_index_primary_card.evidence: tools/reporting/data_product_workspace_index.py adds the existing cross-model HTML as a verified primary card without copying product logic.

reporting_scope_navigation.evidence: The deterministic index exposes all existing scope artifacts and preserves singleton and no-cross-scope boundaries.

download_result_entry_points.evidence: tools/reporting/data_product_release_download.py defines shortlist, workbook, bundle manifest and release notes in ENTRY_POINTS but omits cross-model/cross-model-comparison-view.html.

terminal_summary.evidence: tools/data_product_release_download.py prints five named outputs including the workspace index, but no direct cross-model navigation path.

consumer_guide.evidence: project/guides/data-product-consumer-guide.md still describes four primary products and does not document the cross-model navigation member.

data_and_comparison_semantics.evidence: The v1.9.0 public audit confirms 20 independent scopes, 129 within-scope pairs and no ranking, recommendations, inferred values or cross-scope pairs.

decision.name: Cross-Model Download Discoverability Alignment
decision.goal: Expose the already verified cross-model navigation HTML consistently through release-download metadata, terminal output and the consumer guide, with focused regression coverage and no change to workspace-index rendering, release assets or comparison semantics.
